_about: Evidence for remediate_catalog.flag_propaganda (Decision 149). Flagged items are never recommended (Home, hero, More Like This, channels, Top Shelf, Tonight, Surprise, social) and stay reachable by Search, Detail and Browse. Owner, 2026-09-28: "All true propaganda should be hidden from recommendations, but avaialble via search." Every entry names a source a reader can open.

vorbehaltsfilme.note: Nazi-era films the Friedrich-Wilhelm-Murnau-Stiftung releases only for supervised screenings because of their propaganda content. Matched on title and year (within two years).

not.DeathMills: Death Mills (1945) is the US War Department's film of the liberated camps (Billy Wilder) — Allied evidence, not propaganda of the regime it documents; caught only by its German-language version
